title: SegBench (Lung Xenium / Kidney VisiumHD)
description: Frozen, held-out benchmarking with pinned method containers and manuscript-ready outputs.

dataset_kind.title: Benchmark dataset
dataset_kind.description: Select the lung Xenium or kidney VisiumHD method set.

sample_name.title: Sample name
sample_name.description: Short run label used in result receipts.

run_scope.title: Run scope
run_scope.description: Smoke uses a fixed central subset; full uses the frozen complete input.

seed.title: Frozen seed
seed.description: Locked benchmark seed; Baysor v0.7.1 internally fixes its own seed to 1.

xenium_dir.title: Xenium bundle folder
xenium_dir.description: Dataset-relative folder containing Xenium boundaries, cells and matrix files.

clusters.title: Xenium cluster labels
clusters.description: Vendor cluster labels used by the frozen CellAdmix/common-input adapter.

kidney_seg_input.title: Kidney nucleus assignments
kidney_seg_input.description: Frozen 2-um bin table assigned by the provided nucleus segmentation.

visiumhd_matrix.title: VisiumHD matrix folder
visiumhd_matrix.description: Dataset-relative filtered 2-um Matrix Market folder for TRACER No-seg.

bin2cell_h5.title: Bin2Cell matrix
bin2cell_h5.description: Filtered 2-um HDF5 matrix from the same kidney Space Ranger output.

spaceranger_dir.title: Space Ranger 2-um folder
spaceranger_dir.description: Dataset-relative square_002um folder used by Bin2Cell.

source_image.title: Kidney H&E image
source_image.description: Full-resolution H&E image segmented by the baked StarDist model.

input_manifest.title: Input checksum manifest
input_manifest.description: SHA-256 inventory for every file in the selected Cirro dataset.

pmi.title: PMI/cPMI reference
pmi.description: Required immutable PMI/cPMI table; effective path and SHA-256 are recorded.

reference_train.title: Lung training reference
reference_train.description: Training-only stratified scRNA subset available to SPLIT.

reference_holdout.title: Held-out evaluation reference
reference_holdout.description: Never exposed to SPLIT; the same object evaluates every applicable method.

reference_split_manifest.title: Reference split receipt
reference_split_manifest.description: Frozen membership, strata, source hash and train/holdout hashes.

max_retries.title: OOM/transient retries
max_retries.description: Retries selected OOM/transient exits with scaled memory.

max_memory_gb.title: Retry memory cap (GiB)
max_memory_gb.description: Upper bound for task-attempt memory scaling.

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: Cirro replaces this with the destination dataset path.
